Container.Name: pcontrol
Container.Overview: Parental-control server for Android devices. Stores policy and app/website usage; the companion Android app enforces daily time limits locally. Web dashboard at port 7285.

Config.Name: Web port
Config.Description: Web dashboard and API port (container & host)

Config.Name: Appdata path
Config.Description: Persistent storage for the SQLite database

Config.Name: Admin password hash
Config.Description: bcrypt hash of the admin password. Generate with: docker run --rm -i ghcr.io/hjiang/pcontrol-server hash-password

Config.Name: SMTP host
Config.Description: SMTP host for daily usage reports (leave empty to disable). SMTP must support STARTTLS on the configured port.

Config.Name: SMTP port
Config.Description: SMTP port (default 587; implicit-TLS 465 is not supported)

Config.Name: SMTP From address
Config.Description: From address for the daily reports (optional)

Config.Name: Report send delay
Config.Description: Delay after local midnight before sending the daily report (Go duration, e.g. 3h)
